data_policy: Frozen causal date-prefix reconstruction from real persisted Yahoo closes; historical vendor vintages were retrieved later. Retrospective chronological OOS, NOT an executable historical point-in-time forecast.

protocol.gate: >=1000 OOS origins, >=100 positive labels, >=500 negatives, >=50 distinct events, >=6 folds; >=1% lower BOTH log loss and Brier than BOTH baselines; >=2/3 dual-metric fold wins vs duration, positive gains in all thirds; five fixed-width bins each populated >=30, ECE <=0.05, max gap <=0.10. Entry additionally needs alert recall >=0.25, precision >=2x base rate and false-positive rate <=0.15. No PASS without historical source vintages.
models: same fixed-L2 logistic plus two market scores
protocol.operating_threshold: fold-specific 90th percentile of fitted training scores; OOS untouched
protocol.purge: last training label index < first test origin index - h
protocol.registration: Fixed in code; no independently dated preregistration. Exploratory.
protocol.sensitivity: Only DE-RISK entry; frozen cutoff alternatives 30/70 and 40/60, not selected or tuned.

targets.any_transition: all three origin states; S_(t+h) != S_t (endpoint, not any temporary round-trip)
targets.de_risk_entry: non-DE-RISK origins; first DE-RISK observation in next h sessions
targets.de_risk_exit: DE-RISK origins; first non-DE-RISK observation in next h sessions
